newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Byron, Ill. plant seen down 12 days.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Byron, Ill. plant seen down 12 days.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 1,105 megawatt Byron nuclear power unit 1 is scheduled to be out of service for 12 days following a repair and maintenance later today, a Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) spokesman said Friday.
The unit, located in Byron, Ill., was expected to shut before 2400 CST Friday for scheduled repairs to a leaky feedwater pump gland, the NRC spokesman said.
The unit should be out of service until about Feb 26, the spokesman said.
Byron 1 was operating at 20 percent of capacity as of early Friday and was reducing power, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The facility's adjacent 1,105 megawatt Byron nuclear power unit 2 was operating at full capacity as of early Friday, the NRC said.
ComEd does not comment on scheduled maintenance outages.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
